name: What is the difference between a mid-project cleanup and final jobsite cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a mid-project cleanup and final jobsite cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mid-project cleanup focuses on maintaining a safe and organized work environment by removing daily debris, keeping pathways clear, and managing waste during construction phases. Final jobsite cleanup, however, is a comprehensive effort to leave the entire site spotless, often including professional cleaning services. Frasheski Construction ensures both: ongoing tidiness for safety and a thorough deep clean at completion, particularly important on busy sites in the East Bay area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mid-project cleanup maintains daily safety and organization, while final cleanup is a comprehensive, deep clean of the entire site.
